summary_en: Services and repairs electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers and cars — battery packs, motors, controllers and charging systems.
summary_te: ఎలక్ట్రిక్ ద్విచక్ర, త్రిచక్ర, కార్ల సర్వీసింగ్ — బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్‌లు, మోటార్లు, కంట్రోలర్లు, ఛార్జింగ్ వ్యవస్థలు.
work_en: Reading fault codes with diagnostic tools, testing battery cells and wiring, replacing components, and explaining repairs to vehicle owners.

pathways.title_en: ITI / vocational course in EV or automotive technology
pathways.note_en: Trade courses cover electrical fundamentals, battery systems and vehicle servicing.
Short skill certification, often offered by OEM training arms and sector skill councils.

pathways.title_en: Apprenticeship at a service centre or dealership
pathways.note_en: Paid on-the-job training under an experienced technician.

pathways.title_en: EV technician in a workshop or fleet service team
pathways.title_te: వర్క్‌షాప్ లేదా ఫ్లీట్ సర్వీస్ టీమ్‌లో ఈవీ టెక్నీషియన్
pathways.note_en: Starting role; income depends on employer, city and skill level.
With experience, supervision and own-service-centre options open up.

further_education_en: Lateral entry into a diploma in automobile or electrical engineering (where the institution allows it)
Advanced OEM certifications in battery management systems
NSQF-aligned higher-level qualifications in EV technology
considerations_en: Workshop-based work with standing, lifting and tool use
High-voltage safety training is essential before handling battery packs
Good opportunities cluster around cities with EV service networks
opportunities_en: EV service centres, dealerships and fleet operators
Delivery and transport companies maintaining electric fleets
Independent EV service and battery repair business
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Maintains and repairs petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles at service centres and dealerships.
summary_te: పెట్రోల్, డీజిల్, హైబ్రిడ్ వాహనాల నిర్వహణ మరియు మరమ్మత్తు.
work_en: Engine servicing, brake and suspension work, electrical fault-finding, road tests and service documentation.

pathways.title_en: ITI trade course (Motor Mechanic Vehicle / Automobile)
pathways.note_en: Core trade training with workshop practice.
Manufacturer-specific training improves placement prospects.
Entry role with structured progression in most workshops.
Leads to supervision or an independent workshop.

pathways.title_en: Own workshop or multi-brand service point
pathways.title_te: సొంత వర్క్‌షాప్ లేదా మల్టీ-బ్రాండ్ సర్వీస్ పాయింట్
pathways.note_en: Entrepreneurship route commonly followed by experienced technicians.

further_education_en: Diploma in automobile engineering through lateral entry (institution-dependent)
Advanced diagnostics and hybrid/EV add-on certifications
considerations_en: Physically active workshop role
Tools and safety gear are usually provided by employers
Income grows with specialisation and reputation
opportunities_en: Dealerships, multi-brand workshops and fleet garages
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Sets up and runs computer-controlled machine tools that cut metal parts to precise dimensions.
summary_te: లోహ భాగాలను ఖచ్చితంగా కత్తిరించే కంప్యూటర్ నియంత్రిత యంత్రాల నిర్వహణ.
work_en: Loading programmes, setting tools and offsets, measuring finished parts and inspecting quality.

pathways.note_en: Trade theory plus extensive machine practice.
Short courses in G-code and CAM software.
Common route into production units.
Shift-based industrial employment.
Programming and quality roles pay more than machine operation.

further_education_en: Diploma in mechanical or production engineering (lateral entry, institution-dependent)
Advanced CAM and quality-inspection certifications
considerations_en: Factory environments with shift work and noise
Industrial clusters may be outside your home district
Attention to precision is more important than speed
opportunities_en: Auto-component, aerospace and general engineering units
Tool rooms and precision job shops
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Installs, maintains and repairs electrical wiring, panels, motors and control systems in buildings and factories.
summary_te: భవనాలు, కర్మాగారాల్లో విద్యుత్ వైరింగ్, ప్యానెల్స్, మోటార్ల నిర్వహణ మరియు మరమ్మత్తు.
work_en: Wiring and panel work, testing circuits, preventive maintenance, reading electrical drawings and following safety isolation procedures.

pathways.note_en: Covers wiring, machines, protection devices and safety.

pathways.title_en: Licensed wireman / supervisor certification (state electrical licensing)
pathways.note_en: Licensing requirements are set by the state electricity authority.

pathways.title_en: Apprenticeship with a contractor or industrial unit
pathways.note_en: Apprenticeship routes are listed on the national apprenticeship portal.

pathways.title_en: Electrician in industry, utilities or construction
pathways.title_te: పరిశ్రమ, విద్యుత్ సంస్థ లేదా నిర్మాణంలో ఎలక్ట్రిషియన్
pathways.note_en: Steady demand across all sectors.
Licensed electricians can take up independent contracts.

further_education_en: Diploma in electrical engineering (lateral entry where permitted)
Advanced certifications in solar, automation or switchgear
considerations_en: Electrical work carries shock and height risks — safety discipline is essential
Site work may involve travel within and beyond the district
Licensing requirements vary by state
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Installs, commissions and maintains rooftop and ground-mounted solar power systems.
summary_te: పైకప్పు, నేలపై సోలార్ విద్యుత్ వ్యవస్థల ఏర్పాటు మరియు నిర్వహణ.
work_en: Mounting panels, DC wiring, inverter setup, performance checks and customer handover.

pathways.note_en: Skill-India aligned short courses are widely available.
Certification improves employability with EPC companies.

pathways.title_en: Installer with a solar EPC or service company
pathways.note_en: Field role with site travel.
Operations and maintenance roles are steadier than installation.
Local demand for rooftop systems supports small enterprises.

further_education_en: Diploma in electrical or renewable energy (institution-dependent)
Advanced certifications in storage and hybrid systems
considerations_en: Outdoor work in heat, with rooftop height work
Project demand can be seasonal
Safety harness and DC safety training are essential
opportunities_en: Rooftop solar companies and EPC contractors
Solar farms and O&M service providers
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Joins and fabricates metal structures and components using arc, MIG and TIG welding.
summary_te: ఆర్క్, MIG, TIG వెల్డింగ్ ఉపయోగించి లోహ నిర్మాణాలు తయారు చేయడం.
work_en: Reading fabrication drawings, preparing joints, welding to specification, inspecting welds and maintaining equipment.

pathways.title_en: ITI Welder trade course or short-term welding course
pathways.note_en: Practice-intensive training, often available in short formats.

pathways.title_en: Welder qualification testing (as per industry standard)
pathways.note_en: Qualification tests are often required by fabrication contractors.

pathways.title_en: Welder in fabrication shop or construction site
pathways.title_te: ఫ్యాబ్రికేషన్ షాప్ లేదా నిర్మాణ సైట్‌లో వెల్డర్
pathways.note_en: Contract and project-based work is common.
Specialised welders (pipe, structural) earn more.

pathways.title_en: Own fabrication unit or contract team
pathways.note_en: Experienced fabricators often start small units.

further_education_en: Advanced welding certifications (pipe, structural, aluminium)
Diploma programmes in fabrication technology (institution-dependent)
considerations_en: Hot, noisy and physically demanding work
Safety gear — helmets, gloves, ventilation — is non-negotiable
Project work may require travel and long site hours
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Installs and services air-conditioners, cold rooms and commercial refrigeration equipment.
summary_te: ఎయిర్ కండీషనర్లు, కోల్డ్ రూమ్‌లు, వాణిజ్య రిఫ్రిజిరేషన్ పరికరాల సర్వీసింగ్.
work_en: Installation, gas charging, leak detection, electrical checks in outdoor units and customer-facing service visits.

pathways.note_en: Short formats from skill centres are also available.
Refrigerant handling practice is regulated by environmental rules.

pathways.title_en: Service technician at an appliance brand or dealer
pathways.title_te: అప్లయన్స్ బ్రాండ్ లేదా డీలర్‌లో సర్వీస్ టెక్నీషియన్
pathways.note_en: Field service roles usually include travel within a city.
Brand service franchises are a route to self-employment.

further_education_en: Certifications in commercial refrigeration and cold-chain systems
Diploma in mechanical or refrigeration engineering (institution-dependent)
considerations_en: Height, heat and rooftop work on outdoor units
Summer demand peaks with long working hours
Customer interaction is a large part of the job
opportunities_en: Brand service networks and dealer workshops
Commercial refrigeration for shops, hotels and cold storage
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Maintains automated production lines — sensors, PLC-controlled machines, robotics cells and pneumatic systems.
summary_te: ఆటోమేటెడ్ ఉత్పత్తి లైన్ల నిర్వహణ — సెన్సర్లు, PLC యంత్రాలు, రోబోటిక్స్, న్యూమాటిక్ వ్యవస్థలు.
work_en: Fault-finding on control panels, reading ladder logic, calibrating sensors and reducing machine downtime.

pathways.title_en: Diploma or advanced ITI in mechatronics / instrumentation
pathways.note_en: Longer qualification with stronger technical depth.
Vendor and sector-skill certifications are widely recognised.
Manufacturing plants with automation investment.
Growth follows experience with specific control platforms.

further_education_en: B.Voc or degree in mechatronics/electrical engineering (institution-dependent)
Vendor certifications in robotics and drives
considerations_en: Strong maths and logical reasoning are needed
Shift work and industrial locations
Continuous learning as control systems change
opportunities_en: Automotive, pharma, food-processing and electronics plants
System integrators and automation service firms
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Installs and repairs water supply, drainage and sanitary fittings in homes, buildings and sites.
summary_te: ఇళ్లు, భవనాలు, సైట్లలో నీటి సరఫరా, డ్రైనేజీ, శానిటరీ ఫిట్టింగ్‌ల ఏర్పాటు మరియు మరమ్మత్తు.
work_en: Pipe fitting, leak repair, fixture installation, reading simple layouts and working with customers on site.

pathways.note_en: Short courses are widely available at skill centres.

pathways.title_en: Plumber with a contractor or maintenance team
pathways.note_en: Apprenticeship-style learning on site is common.
Supervision of plumbing crews on larger projects.
Urban demand supports steady self-employment.

further_education_en: Advanced certifications in plumbing systems and water treatment
Diploma programmes in civil or public health engineering (institution-dependent)
considerations_en: Physically demanding work in wet and confined spaces
Self-employment income can vary by season and city
Customer trust and punctuality drive repeat work
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Makes and fits furniture, modular interiors, doors and wooden structures.
summary_te: ఫర్నిచర్, మాడ్యులర్ ఇంటీరియర్స్, తలుపులు, కలప నిర్మాణాల తయారీ మరియు అమరిక.
work_en: Reading drawings, cutting and joining wood or boards, fitting at site and finishing work.

pathways.note_en: Traditional workshop apprenticeship plus formal trade training.

pathways.title_en: Carpenter at a furniture workshop or interiors contractor
pathways.title_te: ఫర్నిచర్ వర్క్‌షాప్ లేదా ఇంటీరియర్స్ కాంట్రాక్టర్‌లో కార్పెంటర్
pathways.note_en: Skill-based pay in modular interiors.
CNC woodworking and modular skills increase earnings.
Common route once a customer base is built.

further_education_en: Certifications in modular furniture and CNC woodworking
Diploma in interior design (institution-dependent, portfolio-based entry)
considerations_en: Dust, noise and physical work
Progress depends on building a portfolio of finished work
Site fitting may involve travel within the city
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Coordinates workers, materials and quality checks on building and infrastructure sites.
summary_te: భవన నిర్మాణ సైట్లలో కార్మికులు, సామగ్రి, నాణ్యత తనిఖీల సమన్వయం.
work_en: Daily work planning, measurement and quality checks, material tracking, safety compliance and reporting to the engineer.

pathways.title_en: Diploma in civil engineering or construction trade progression
pathways.note_en: Formal diploma is the usual route; skilled workers can progress with experience.
Safety certifications are increasingly required on large projects.

pathways.title_en: Site supervisor on building or infrastructure projects
pathways.note_en: Project-based employment, often with travel.
Coordination roles move toward project management.

further_education_en: Degree in civil engineering (institution-dependent progression routes)
Project management and safety certifications
considerations_en: Long hours on site, in all weather
Frequent travel or posting away from home district
Responsibility for worker safety
opportunities_en: Housing, roads, industrial and infrastructure projects
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Supports dentists with instruments, sterilisation, patient preparation and clinic records.
summary_te: వైద్యుల పరికరాలు, స్టెరిలైజేషన్, రోగుల సన్నద్ధత, క్లినిక్ రికార్డుల నిర్వహణ.
work_en: Preparing and sterilising instruments, assisting during procedures, managing appointments and keeping records.

pathways.note_en: Often offered at dental colleges and skill centres.
Entry role; infection-control discipline is central.
Front-desk and clinic management roles follow.

pathways.title_en: Dental hygiene or dental technician qualification
pathways.note_en: Further formal education opens higher-skilled roles.

further_education_en: Diploma in dental mechanics / dental hygienist programmes where available
Front-office and health-records management certifications
considerations_en: Long periods of standing and close patient contact
Infection-control protocols must be followed strictly
Healthcare roles often involve six-day work weeks
opportunities_en: Dental clinics and multi-speciality dental chains
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Collects samples and performs routine diagnostic tests in hospital and private laboratories.
summary_te: ఆసుపత్రి, ప్రైవేట్ ల్యాబ్‌లలో నమూనాల సేకరణ మరియు పరీక్షలు.
work_en: Sample handling, operating analysers, recording results accurately, maintaining quality control and lab hygiene.

pathways.note_en: Paramedical diplomas are offered by recognised institutions.
Supervised lab practice is usually part of the diploma.

pathways.title_en: Lab technician in hospital or diagnostic centre
pathways.title_te: ఆసుపత్రి లేదా డయాగ్నస్టిక్ సెంటర్‌లో ల్యాబ్ టెక్నీషియన్
pathways.note_en: Shift work is common in hospital labs.

pathways.title_en: Senior technician → lab supervisor / quality coordinator
pathways.note_en: Quality and accreditation roles add responsibility.

further_education_en: B.Sc in medical laboratory technology (institution-dependent eligibility)
Specialised certifications in microbiology or clinical biochemistry
considerations_en: Biological sample handling requires strict safety practice
Shift duties including nights in hospital settings
Accuracy matters more than speed — errors affect patient care
opportunities_en: Public health laboratories and blood banks
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Provides bedside care and daily-living support to patients in hospitals and home-care settings.
summary_te: ఆసుపత్రులు, హోమ్ కేర్‌లో రోగులకు సంరక్షణ మరియు రోజువారీ సహాయం.
work_en: Assisting with movement and hygiene, monitoring basic vitals, feeding support and reporting changes to nurses.

pathways.title_en: General duty assistant / patient care course
pathways.note_en: Short-term, healthcare-sector skill courses.

pathways.title_en: Care assistant in hospital ward or home care
pathways.title_te: ఆసుపత్రి వార్డ్ లేదా హోమ్ కేర్‌లో అసిస్టెంట్
pathways.note_en: Ward and home-care roles differ in pace and independence.
Supervision and scheduling roles follow with experience.
Further education opens clinical career paths.

further_education_en: Paramedical or nursing assistant diplomas (eligibility varies by institution)
Elder-care and home-care specialisations
considerations_en: Emotionally and physically demanding work
Shift duties including nights
Requires patience and strong communication
opportunities_en: Hospitals, nursing homes and elder-care facilities
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Supports pharmacy operations — dispensing under supervision, stock control, billing and customer guidance.
summary_te: ఫార్మసీ నిర్వహణ — స్టాక్, బిల్లింగ్, కస్టమర్ సహాయం.
work_en: Reading prescriptions, arranging medicines, managing expiry and stock, billing and explaining dosage instructions.

pathways.note_en: Note: dispensing medicines is regulated; assistants work under a qualified pharmacist.

pathways.title_en: Assistant at a retail pharmacy or hospital pharmacy
pathways.note_en: Entry role with in-store training.

pathways.title_en: Senior assistant / store and inventory in-charge
pathways.note_en: Inventory and compliance skills drive progression.
Qualification requirements are set by the pharmacy regulator.

further_education_en: D.Pharm (regulatory eligibility applies)
Supply-chain and inventory management certifications
considerations_en: Regulatory limits on what an assistant may dispense
Standing work with high customer interaction
Accuracy in stock and expiry control is critical
opportunities_en: Retail pharmacy chains and hospital pharmacies
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Creates visual content — branding, social media creatives, print and basic motion graphics.
summary_te: బ్రాండింగ్, సోషల్ మీడియా క్రియేటివ్స్, ప్రింట్, మోషన్ గ్రాఫిక్స్ రూపకల్పన.
work_en: Understanding briefs, working in design software, iterating with clients and preparing files for print or digital output.

pathways.note_en: Short courses plus a self-built portfolio are the practical entry route.

pathways.title_en: Junior designer at an agency, print house or in-house team
pathways.note_en: Entry roles are usually portfolio-driven, not marks-driven.
Specialisation in brand, UI or motion improves rates.
Freelance work is common and can be location-independent.

further_education_en: Degree or diploma in visual communication / design (portfolio-based admission)
Specialisations in UI/UX or motion design
considerations_en: Portfolio quality matters more than qualification alone
Client feedback and revisions are part of the work
Freelance income can be irregular at the start
opportunities_en: Advertising agencies, print and packaging businesses
In-house teams for retail, real estate and education brands
Freelance and remote work for national clients
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Creates, tailors and finishes garments — pattern making, stitching, alteration and boutique work.
summary_te: దుస్తుల తయారీ — ప్యాటర్న్, కుట్టు, ఆల్టరేషన్, బూటిక్ పని.
work_en: Taking measurements, drafting patterns, stitching and finishing garments, and working directly with customers.

pathways.note_en: Short-term courses cover pattern making and machine stitching.

pathways.title_en: Tailor / stitching technician at a boutique or garment unit
pathways.note_en: Piece-rate and salaried roles both exist.
Garment export units offer sampling and quality roles.
Small capital and local demand support self-employment.

further_education_en: Diploma or degree in fashion design (portfolio-based admission)
Specialisations in garment technology or merchandising
considerations_en: Piece-rate work can mean variable income early on
Long sitting hours at machines
Festival seasons bring peak demand
opportunities_en: Boutiques, tailoring shops and alteration services
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Serves guests in restaurants, banquets and hotels — service, order taking and guest relations.
summary_te: రెస్టారెంట్లు, బ్యాంకెట్లలో అతిథి సేవ, ఆర్డర్ తీసుకోవడం, సంబంధాలు.
work_en: Setting up service areas, taking orders, serving food and beverage, handling billing and guest requests.

pathways.note_en: Hospitality sector skill courses include service practice and grooming.

pathways.title_en: Service associate in a hotel or restaurant
pathways.note_en: Entry roles often include shift and weekend work.
Language skills and guest handling drive promotion.

pathways.title_en: Food service outlet owner / catering business
pathways.note_en: Catering and small outlets are a common transition.

further_education_en: Diploma or degree in hotel management (institution-dependent)
Certifications in barista, banquet or front-office operations
considerations_en: Late shifts, weekends and festival peaks
Standing and walking for most of the shift
Presentation and communication standards are high
opportunities_en: Hotels, resorts, restaurants and banquet halls
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Operates, maintains and repairs tractors, harvesters and farm machinery, including custom hiring services.
summary_te: ట్రాక్టర్లు, హార్వెస్టర్లు, వ్యవసాయ యంత్రాల నిర్వహణ మరియు మరమ్మత్తు.
work_en: Field operation, routine servicing, minor repairs, safety checks and customer support for machinery owners.

pathways.note_en: Skill courses for farm machinery operation and repair are available at rural skill centres.

pathways.title_en: Operator or service technician at a machinery dealer / custom hiring centre
pathways.title_te: మెషినరీ డీలర్ లేదా కస్టమ్ హైరింగ్ సెంటర్‌లో టెక్నీషియన్
pathways.note_en: Custom hiring centres and dealers employ trained operators.
Operating your own machinery for hire is a common earning model.

pathways.title_en: Own machinery rental and repair service
pathways.note_en: Requires capital or a financing route.

further_education_en: Certifications in modern farm machinery and precision agriculture
Diploma in agricultural engineering (institution-dependent)
considerations_en: Seasonal demand peaks during sowing and harvest
Outdoor work in heat and dust
Ownership of machinery needs financing
opportunities_en: Farm machinery dealers and service networks
Custom hiring centres and farmer collectives
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Assembles, maintains and repairs drones used in agriculture spraying, surveying and inspections.
summary_te: వ్యవసాయ స్ప్రేయింగ్, సర్వే, తనిఖీల్లో ఉపయోగించే డ్రోన్‌ల అమరిక మరియు నిర్వహణ.
work_en: Propeller, motor and electronics repairs, firmware updates, pre-flight checks and field support.

pathways.title_en: Drone technology / remote pilot skill course
pathways.note_en: Short courses cover drone assembly, maintenance and flight rules.

pathways.title_en: Remote pilot certification (as required by aviation rules)
pathways.note_en: Flying drones commercially requires certification under the applicable rules.

pathways.title_en: Drone service technician or field operator
pathways.note_en: Agri-drone service companies and survey firms are the main employers.

pathways.title_en: Drone service business / spraying service operator
pathways.note_en: Service-per-acre models are growing in agriculture.

further_education_en: Advanced certifications in surveying, mapping or agri-spraying operations
Diploma programmes in electronics or aerospace (institution-dependent)
considerations_en: Regulatory compliance and certification are mandatory
Field work in rural areas with travel
Technology changes quickly — continuous learning needed
opportunities_en: Agri-drone service providers and agri-input companies

summary_en: Assembles, tests and repairs printed circuit boards, consumer electronics and small electronic devices.
summary_te: పీసీబీలు, ఎలక్ట్రానిక్ పరికరాల అసెంబ్లీ, పరీక్షలు మరియు మరమ్మత్తు.
work_en: Component assembly, soldering, using test equipment, fault tracing and quality documentation in a production setting.

pathways.title_en: ITI / skill course in electronics mechanic or ESDM assembly
pathways.note_en: Trade training covers components, soldering, testing and safety.

pathways.title_en: Apprenticeship at an electronics manufacturing unit
pathways.note_en: Apprenticeships are common in electronics manufacturing clusters.

pathways.title_en: Assembly / test technician on a production line
pathways.note_en: Electronics clusters offer large numbers of entry roles.

pathways.title_en: Quality inspector → line supervisor → repair specialist
pathways.note_en: Test, quality and repair roles pay above assembly lines.

further_education_en: Diploma in electronics or ECE (institution-dependent lateral entry)
Certifications in SMT assembly, testing or embedded basics
considerations_en: Shift-based factory work with repetitive tasks at entry level
Electronics clusters are in specific locations — relocation may be needed
ESD and precision discipline are important
opportunities_en: Electronics manufacturing clusters and component units
Consumer appliance assembly and service companies
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
